countedBy: lane (opus) from the rectified Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas w02-308 (recording_2025-06-19_06-21-49_00258) and w07-307 / w06-307, 2026-11-01; not a blind count

facades.name: Turfpakhuizen front (NW, three point gables)
facades.note: Bands from the bottom: street storey (4 basket arches and 6 small round-headed lights), storeys 1 and 2 (14 axes each: 3 per side gable, 8 in the middle gable), gable storey 3 (one wide window per side gable, 6 in the middle gable), gable storey 4 (2 wide windows in the middle gable, one small light per side gable).

facades.name: Huiszittenhuis front (NW, risalit with pediment)
facades.note: Souterrain (8 windows and the door under the perron), bel-etage (8 windows, the front door and the light over it), upper storey 9 windows; one pediment. The perron hides part of the souterrain door.
